title: Google links phone numbers to Android accounts
excerpt: Google automatically connects your phone number across multiple Android accounts when you add a new SIM or sign into new profiles.
body_html:
Google has implemented a feature on Android devices that automatically connects phone numbers across multiple user accounts. According to recent reports, inserting a new SIM card into a phone links that phone number to all existing Google accounts present on the device.

Additionally, any new Google accounts added to the device will automatically inherit the connected phone number. This happens quietly in the background without explicit prompts detailing how the number is shared across different profiles linked to the same hardware.
